EC1: 1. Life expectancy lower than 3 months from the initiation of treatment with ICIs.
EC2: 2. Proven hypersensitivity [OR] or previous allergic anaphylactic reaction induced by a specific ICI.
EC3: 3. Active autoimmune disease with severe involvement.
EC4: 4. Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status ≥ 3.
EC5: 5. Ongoing immunosuppressive therapy: prednisone at doses >10 mg/day [OR] or equivalent (>1.5 mg/day of dexamethasone), and/or any dose of azathioprine, [OR] methotrexate, [OR] mycophenolate, [OR] cyclophosphamide, [OR] leflunomide, [OR] rituximab, [OR] anti-tumor necrosis factor drugs (infliximab, [OR] etanercept, [OR] adalimumab, [OR] golimumab), belimumab [OR] and abatacept.
